segments.name: Dollar Tree
segments.description: Operates Dollar Tree discount variety stores in the United States and Canada, selling everyday consumables and seasonal, discretionary merchandise to value-focused customers.
segments.evidence: We are a leading operator of retail discount stores operating under the brand names of Dollar Tree and Dollar Tree Canada.

revenueModel.text: Shoppers pay in Dollar Tree stores or online for everyday consumables, seasonal and discretionary merchandise delivered same-day.
revenueModel.evidence: Through a partnership with Instacart, our customers can shop online and receive same-day delivery from more than 8,400 Dollar Tree stores, as of January 31, 2026, without having to visit a store.

changes.text: Sold the Family Dollar business in 2025; its results are reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On July 5, 2025, we completed our previously announced sale of the Family Dollar business to 1959 Holdings, LLC.
